formulation: lyophilized powder for intravenous injection after reconstitution
moa: plasma-derived C1 esterase inhibitor replacement (regulates the contact and complement cascades)

approval_evidence.quote: CINRYZE (C1 Esterase Inhibitor [Human]) For Intravenous Use, Freeze-Dried Powder for Reconstitution Initial U.S. Approval: 2008. (CINRYZE package insert, FDA CBER product page https://www.fda.gov/vaccines-blood-biologics/approved-blood-products/cinryze, STN 125267)

series_start_reason: Series starts 2008Q4, the quarter ViroPharma first sold Cinryze: the product became commercially available in December 2008 and the FY2009 Form 10-K prints 2008 Cinryze net product sales of $23 thousand (the Form 10-Q for the third quarter of 2009 prints a dash for nine-month 2008, so the 2008 figure is December). The series joins three issuers on the same worldwide Cinryze net-sales scope: ViroPharma (2008Q4-2013Q3, Forms 10-K and 10-Q), Shire (2014Q2-2018Q3, results releases and results presentations) and Takeda (2018Q4 onward). ViroPharma's last periodic report is the Form 10-Q for the third quarter of 2013 and it filed no fourth-quarter 2013 results; Shire acquired it on January 24, 2014. Shire's Q1 2014 release prints Cinryze product sales of $85.6 million for only the first two months after closing, so 2013Q4 and 2014Q1 have no full-quarter figure and are listed in unreported_quarters. Shire's last periodic report is the Form 10-Q for the third quarter of 2018 and it published nothing for the fourth quarter of 2018; the 2018Q4 row is Takeda's pro forma column for legacy Shire. Takeda's own line starts 2019Q1 (the first quarter after it completed the Shire acquisition; the FY2018 column of that table is headed 'Takeda 12 Months @ Actual rate, Shire 3 Months @ Actual rate').
notes: Scope is Takeda's worldwide Cinryze line: the total column of the 'Product Sales Analysis' table (Bn JPY, 'Sales amount includes royalty income and service income'). Takeda marks Cinryze as a plasma-derived (PDT) product by footnote (e.g. '*6 PDT products' in the FY2023 Q4 report). The regional split of 2019Q1 is not printed. No launch quarter is cited (the dated U.S. launch is not in a document gathered here). Label printed: 'Cinryze *1' / 'Cinryze *2' (FY2018-FY2019), 'CINRYZE *n' (FY2020 onward); the footnote marker changes with the table, the line does not. Before Takeda: ViroPharma's line is 'Cinryze' in its revenues table of net product sales (US$ thousands, worldwide; EU sales, which appear in the 2012 Forms 10-Q, are inside the line). Shire's line is the CINRYZE product-sales row of its results releases to Q3 2017 and of its results presentations from Q4 2017 (whole US$ millions from Q1 2018); Shire's 2018 releases and 10-Qs print franchise totals only. Shire's Q4 2017 row (240.6) equals the 10-K full-year figure (699.3) less the nine-month figure (458.7). 2018Q2-2018Q4 (and for Cinryze and Firazyr only 2018Q4) are Takeda's FY2018 pro forma columns in the FY2019 Q1 data book (qr2019_q1_d_en_revised.pdf): legacy Shire's product sales for April 2018-March 2019, US GAAP, excluding the oncology business divested in August 2018, converted to JPY at the FY2018 actual rate, as if the acquisition had occurred on April 1, 2018. Takeda warns that pro forma figures may not represent what sales would have been; the fiscal Q4 FY2018 pro forma figure equals the figure Takeda reports in its own FY2018 Q4 statements for the Shire three-month column, which is the existing first row of the series.
search_log: fetched the takeda.com quarterly-results pages for 2014-2025 and the current page, plus the legacy Shire financial-results page, and collected every PDF/XLSX link (work/takeda_links.json); downloaded the PDFs from FY2014 onward and the Shire press releases/presentations from FY2013 onward (work/pdf), scanned them with pdftotext for the brand names, then re-read each cited page with pdfplumber (the verifier's extractor) so quoted figures match its text layer
Bigdata.com was not used: the issuer's own IR documents were located directly from the takeda.com pages

ladder rung a/b: Takeda prints the brand on its own line in the product sales analysis of every quarterly document from the FY2018 Q4 summary of financial statements onward (FY2018 Q4 summary; FY2019 data books; FY2020-FY2026 quarterly financial reports); no fuller supplement or other issuer was needed

each quarter was read from the quarter's own document (the FY2018 Q4 summary of financial statements, the FY2019 Q1-Q4 data books, the FY2020 Q1 - FY2026 Q1 quarterly financial reports) as current, not from a later comparative column, unless stated in that row's context

cross-check: for each fiscal year FY2019-FY2025 the four quarterly values were summed and compared with the full-year product figure printed in the Q4 document (differences at most 0.1 billion JPY, rounding)

FY2025 Q4 has two versions on takeda.com (original of 2026-05-13, marked as superseded, and the version amended on 2026-06-05 for a subsequent event); the cited document is the amended version, the product-line figures are identical in both

Shire (the prior owner) printed this brand in USD in its own quarterly press releases (legacy Shire documents on the takeda.com Shire page, FY2013-FY2018); those documents were located but not extracted or spliced, because the issuer, currency and revenue definition differ from Takeda's JPY line
EDGAR was not searched: the Takeda quarterly documents on takeda.com were sufficient for every quarter

Reopened to extend the start. Shire plc (CIK 936402) item 2.02 8-Ks 2008-2018 listed through data.sec.gov submissions (recent plus older files pages) and every exhibit 99 downloaded; Cinryze appears in Shire's product-sales tables from the Q1 2014 release (the first release after the ViroPharma closing) to the Q3 2017 release; the Q4 2017 release and the 2018 releases (0000936402-18-000003, -000011, -000052, -000094) print HAE and hematology franchise totals only, and the 2017-2018 10-Qs/10-K print no Cinryze row, so the 2017Q4-2018Q3 rows come from Shire's results presentations on takeda.com (Legacy-Shire pages, FY2017_Q4 to FY2018_Q3 presentations).

Shire filed no Form 10-K for 2018 and no results for the fourth quarter of 2018 (filing list for CIK 936402 ends with the 2018-11-01 Form 10-Q and 8-Ks, 25-NSE on 2019-01-08, Form 15 on 2019-02-07); Takeda's FY2019 Q1 data book (qr2019_q1_d_en_revised.pdf) prints legacy Shire's Cinryze sales for fiscal Q1-Q4 FY2018 in a pro forma column, giving 2018Q4 (fiscal Q3 FY2018) of 5.1 Bn JPY. The fiscal Q1 and Q2 FY2018 pro forma figures (14.8, 13.0) are not used because Shire's own US$ results presentations print those quarters (147, 136 and 117 US$ millions for Q1-Q3 2018).

ViroPharma Incorporated (CIK 946840): item 2.02 8-Ks and Forms 10-K/10-Q 2009-2013 downloaded from EDGAR; the revenues table of each Form 10-Q prints 'Cinryze' net product sales for the quarter; fourth quarters are the Form 10-K full-year figure less the Form 10-Q nine-month figure (the earnings releases give the Cinryze fourth quarter only as rounded prose). The FY2008 Form 10-K prints no Cinryze sales split; the FY2009 Form 10-K comparative column gives 2008 as $23 thousand.

No ViroPharma fourth-quarter 2013 results or 2013 Form 10-K exist: the last 10-Q is for September 30, 2013 and the filing list for CIK 946840 after that shows 8-Ks, tender-offer documents, the closing 8-K of 2014-01-24 and the Form 15-12G of 2014-02-04, and no 2013 Form 10-K. Shire's Q1 2014 release (0000950103-14-003162) prints $85.6 million for the first two months after the January 24, 2014 closing; no document prints a full-quarter figure for either quarter.

Earlier than 2008Q4: Cinryze was approved by the FDA on October 10, 2008 and the Form 10-K for 2008 says it became commercially available in December 2008; the Form 10-Q for the third quarter of 2009 prints a dash for nine-month 2008 Cinryze sales. Lev Pharmaceuticals, the previous developer, was acquired by ViroPharma in October 2008 (Form 10-K for 2008), the quarter of launch.

launch_evidence.quote: The FDA approved Cinryze for routine prophylaxis against angioedema attacks in adolescent and adult patients with hereditary angioedema on October 10, 2008. Cinryze became commercially available for routine prophylaxis against HAE in December 2008

unreported_quarters.2013Q4: Ownership change ViroPharma to Shire; no full-quarter figure is published. ViroPharma's last periodic report is the Form 10-Q for the quarter ended September 30, 2013 (filed 2013-10-31) and its later filings are 8-Ks and tender-offer documents about the Shire acquisition, the closing 8-K of 2014-01-24 and a Form 15-12G (2014-02-04); it filed no fourth-quarter 2013 results and no Form 10-K for 2013.
unreported_quarters.2014Q1: Ownership change ViroPharma to Shire; no full-quarter figure is published. Shire acquired ViroPharma on January 24, 2014; its Q1 2014 release prints Cinryze product sales of $85.6 million 'in the first two months post acquisition' and describes a pro forma growth rate without printing a full-quarter pro forma figure, so the partial-quarter figure is not used.

reviewed_anomalies.2018Q4: Currency step: Shire's rows up to 2018Q3 are in US dollars, and this quarter is the first Takeda-published figure, in Japanese yen. Shire published no figure for the quarter (it was acquired on January 8, 2019 and filed no periodic report after the Q3 2018 Form 10-Q), and Takeda's FY2019 Q1 data book prints legacy Shire's product sales for October-December 2018 in its FY2018 pro forma column, converted to JPY at the FY2018 actual rate. The tenfold-plus jump in the as-reported number is the unit change, not a market move.
